label: Tamsin Vale's first greeting — road stories with teeth

purpose.value: Tamsin greets the hero with a trader's warmth and hides the truth in road stories: the gates he keeps forcing were built for envoys and wagons like hers, and some of the people behind them are her old customers.

emotionalProgression.note: She feeds him, jokes with him, and calls warmth a strategy — it has outlasted every other strategy so far.
A tale of the old diplomatic roads, told lightly: routes between people who were glad to see her wagon.
He enjoys the story as local color about enemy supply lines; the smile stays up because it is her last open door.

notes: Grounded bewilderment, trader register: she knows the gates are diplomatic (hintable, not stated as archive proof — she is no Warden) and only suspects the book's true genre, so no book reference from her. Pair: her fond road stories are heard as intelligence on enemy logistics. Never validate the hero's prophecy framing: there is no canon fact supporting 'the realms are evil', and that absence is itself the guard.
